1. Impacted Products

  • VMware Cloud Foundation

2. Introduction

Node.js Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write remote code execution vulnerability. Workarounds are available to remediate this vulnerability in affected Broadcom products. 

3. SDDC Manager remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-111497)

Description: 
Node.js as used in SDDC manager contains a remote code-execution vulnerability due to an out-of-bounds write issue in Brotli decoder. Broadcom has evaluated the severity of this issue to be in the Critical severity range with a maximum CVSSv3 base score of 9.8. Note that this critical score applies only to SDDC Manager 9.1.1.x; older releases are not critically impacted by this vulnerability.

Known Attack Vectors:
A malicious actor with network access to SDDC Manager may exploit this issue to execute arbitrary code.

Resolution: 
To remediate CVE-2026-111497 apply the patches listed in the 'Fixed Version' column of the 'Response Matrix' found below.

Workarounds:
See the Response Matrix.
